caption:
Engine off, the boat turning slowly on its own, and nobody moved for a while.
Two of them out on the bow, the hills of Madeira going dark behind, the sun still hanging over the water on the right.
We stay out here until it drops, then we take the last light home.
O mar todo dourado.
We keep it to five guests. Message us with your dates and we'll see what fits.
